description.value: Black Kettle Brewing Company is a North Shore craft brewery and taproom that has been pouring house-crafted ales and lagers since opening in January 2014, founded by Bryan Lockhart and Phil Vanderborre in a no-frills industrial unit just past the rail tracks. The about page describes it as 'minutes down the Spirit Trail' and 'a casual & pet-friendly oasis,' making it a natural pit-stop for cyclists finishing a ride on the North Shore trail network. The kitchen turns out burgers, tacos, salads, and wings, and the pet-friendly patio hosts live music on Saturdays.
